title: Add up the numbers in one column of a CSV file
summary: Read a comma-separated file, skip the header line, add up the values of one column, and print the total. Handy for quick totals from an export without a spreadsheet.

aliases.text: sum a column in csv linux
add up numbers in csv column command line
sum values in second column of text file
calculate total from csv in terminal
посчитать итог из csv в терминале

steps.explain: Look at the first lines to find the column number of the amount. Columns are numbered from 1.
steps.expect: Comma-separated rows. The first row is usually the header with column names.

steps.explain: Add up one column. -F, makes awk split each line at commas. NR > 1 skips the header row. The END block prints the sum once all lines are read. Quoted values containing commas are not handled.
steps.expect: A single number such as 4216.5, printed on one line.

placeholders.name: COL
placeholders.description: Column number holding the amounts, counted from 1

alternatives.explain: Show only that column, without adding it up. cut -d, splits at commas and -f picks the field.
